MedGemma.title: Monocytic/Macrophage-like
MedGemma.description: This cluster is characterized by high expression of CD117, CD14, CD68, and CD163, and low expression of DNA1, FoxP3, HLADR, and Pancytokeratin. The high CD117 and CD68 levels, along with the low DNA1 and Pancytokeratin, are suggestive of a monocyte/macrophage-like population. The presence of CD14 and CD163 further supports this interpretation, as these markers are commonly expressed in macrophages and monocytes. The low expression of DNA1 and HLADR is consistent with a non-hematopoietic cell type. The UMAP centroid location (3.93, 6.71) indicates a position within the spatial context of the dataset, potentially reflecting a specific region of the lung tissue.

BioMistral.title: Perivascular CD11c+CD163+ macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD14, and CD163. The cluster also contains some CD117+ cells, which may represent a mixed population of macrophages and mast cells. The low expression of DNA1, FoxP3, HLADR, MPO, and TTF1 suggests that this cluster does not contain significant numbers of lymphoid or epithelial cells. The high expression of CD31 and CD3 suggests that this cluster may contain some endothelial cells or immune cells in close proximity to blood vessels. The high expression of CD4 and CD68 also suggests that this cluster may contain some T cells and other immune cells. The low expression of CD8a and CD94 suggests that this cluster does not contain significant numbers of NK cells. The high expression of CD16 suggests that this cluster may contain some neutrophils. The low expression of Pancytokeratin suggests that this cluster does not contain significant numbers of epithelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, Mesenchymal-like
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a mesenchymal-like population, possibly including fibroblasts or myofibrob lasts, given the high expression of CD11c, CD14, CD163, MPO, and CD3. The presence of CD20 and CD3 suggests the possible co-existence of immune cells, potentially involved in tissue remodeling or fibrosis. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1) and markers like CD94, HLADR, and DNA1 is consistent with a non-epithelial phenotype. The overall profile suggests a cell type involved in tissue support and potentially immune modulation, possibly contributing to the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Immunosuppressive CD11c+CD163+ macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD163, and MPO. The presence of CD14 and CD31 suggests a tissue-resident macrophage phenotype. Low expression of CD94 and HLADR suggests an immunosuppressive state. The presence of CD16 and CD31 may indicate a pro-angiogenic phenotype. Low expression of CD20, CD3, CD4, CD68, CD8a, and TTF1 suggests a lack of lymphoid cells and epithelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial-like cells with immune cell co-localization
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly tumor cells, given the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The presence of CD117 suggests a potential role in tumor growth or differentiation. The co-localization of immune cells, including CD8a, CD68, and CD14, suggests a potential immune response to the tumor. The low expression of CD20 and CD3 may indicate a lack of B-cell involvement. The overall profile is suggestive of a tumor-associated epithelial cell population interacting with the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Proliferative TTF1+ tumour epithelium
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1. They are also enriched in DNA1, a marker of cell proliferation, and HLADR, a marker of antigen presentation. These cells are surrounded by low-intensity CD11c, CD14, and CD68, suggesting a low immune infiltrate. The cluster is also characterized by low expression of MPO, a marker of neutrophils, and CD20, a marker of B cells. The cluster is enriched in CD117, a marker of mast cells, and CD94, a marker of natural killer cells. The cluster is also characterized by low expression of CD31, a marker of endothelial cells, and CD3, a marker of T cells. The cluster is enriched in CD4, a marker of helper T cells, and FoxP3, a marker of regulatory T cells. The cluster is also characterized by low expression of CD163, a marker of macrophages, and CD16, a marker of natural killer cells.

MedGemma.title: Monocyte-Rich Area
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a monocyte-rich area, consistent with the high expression of CD68 and MPO. The low expression of CD8a and TTF1 suggests a less activated or differentiated state compared to other immune cell populations. The presence of CD14 and CD163 could indicate a macrophage-like phenotype, potentially involved in tissue remodeling or immune suppression. The high Pancytokeratin expression may indicate epithelial cell presence, suggesting a possible interaction between the monocyte-rich area and the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Proliferative CD163+ myeloid–epithelial mix
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD163, CD11c, and CD68. The cluster also contains some T cells (CD3, CD8a), B cells (CD20), and epithelial cells (Pancytokeratin). The presence of CD117 and CD14 suggests that some mast cells and monocytes may also be present. The cluster has a high expression of DNA1, which is consistent with a proliferative state. The low expression of CD94 and HLADR suggests that this cluster is not enriched for activated T cells or other immune cells. The low expression of TTF1 suggests that this cluster is not enriched for lung epithelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Immune-Suppressive Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of macrophages with a suppressive phenotype. The high expression of CD68 and MPO, coupled with low expression of markers associated with activation (e.g., CD117, CD14, CD163, CD16, CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8a, HLADR, FoxP3), suggests a state of immune suppression. The high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1 could indicate a tumor-associated macrophage (TAM) population, potentially contributing to the tumor microenvironment. The low expression of DNA1 is consistent with a less actively proliferating cell population. The overall profile is suggestive of a population that may be involved in remodeling the tumor microenvironment and/or suppressing anti-tumor immune responses.

BioMistral.title: Immune-suppressive MPO+ macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD163, and MPO. The cluster also contains low expression of CD68, which is consistent with a macrophage-like phenotype. The presence of CD117 and CD14 suggests that some neutrophils and monocytes may also be present. The low expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1 suggests that epithelial cells are not a major component of this cluster.

MedGemma.title: MPO/HLADR+ Epithelial-like Cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial cells, possibly with a degree of differentiation or activation, given the high expression of MPO and HLADR. The presence of Pancytokeratin and TTF1 further supports this interpretation. The low expression of immune markers like CD3, CD4, CD8, CD11c, CD20, and CD94 is consistent with a non-immune cell population. The high DNA1 intensity suggests a potentially proliferative state. The overall profile is suggestive of a non-immune epithelial cell population, possibly with some degree of activation or differentiation.

BioMistral.title: Immune-hot MPO/HLADR+ macrophage niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of MPO and HLADR. The cluster also contains some neutrophils (MPO+), and low expression of T cells (CD3-, FoxP3-). The presence of CD11c+ cells suggests that there may be some dendritic cells or other myeloid cells present. The high expression of DNA1 and Pancytokeratin suggests that there may be some epithelial cells present as well. The cluster is likely enriched for immune cells and may represent an inflammatory or immune-hot region.

MedGemma.title: CD117+ Monocytes/Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster is likely enriched in CD117+ monocytes/macrophages, given the high expression of CD117 and MPO, and the low expression of CD31, CD3, CD4, and CD8a. The high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1 suggests a possible epithelial-like component, potentially reflecting a role in tissue remodeling or immune modulation. The presence of CD14 and CD68 further supports a macrophage-like phenotype. The low expression of CD16, CD163, CD94, and CD20 is consistent with a less activated or differentiated state. The overall profile is suggestive of a myeloid-rich niche with a potential for tissue repair or immune regulation.

BioMistral.title: Immune-cold TTF1+ tumour epithelium
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1, and low expression of immune markers. These cells are likely to be proliferative, as indicated by high DNA1 expression.

MedGemma.title: FoxP3+ Regulatory T cells

BioMistral.title: CD11c+CD117+ macrophage/T-cell niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD117, CD163, and CD68. The cluster also contains some T cells (CD3, CD4, CD8a) and B cells (CD20). The presence of CD14 and CD16 suggests that these macrophages may be M2-like. The cluster is characterized by low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1) and DNA1, which is consistent with a non-epithelial cell type. The cluster also contains some CD94+ cells, which may represent NK cells or other myeloid cells. The cluster has a high average intensity for most markers, indicating strong marker expression.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, Fibroblast-associated
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of the tumour microenvironment characterized by a high density of immune cells, particularly macrophages and possibly fibroblasts. The elevated expression of CD68 and CD163, along with CD117 and CD31, suggests a macrophage-rich niche. The presence of CD94 and CD117 could indicate the presence of certain myeloid cell subsets. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1) and B-cell markers (CD20) is consistent with a non-epithelial, immune-dominant environment. The high expression of CD3 and CD8a could indicate the presence of cytotoxic T cells. The presence of FoxP3 is suggestive of regulatory T cells, which may be involved in modulating the immune response within the tumour microenvironment. The overall picture is suggestive of an immune-rich, fibroblast-associated region with potential for immune regulation.

BioMistral.title: FoxP3+ CD117+CD163+ macrophage niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD117, CD163, and CD68. The cluster also contains low expression of CD11c, MPO, and CD20, suggesting a lack of neutrophils, eosinophils, and B cells. The presence of CD94 and FoxP3 may indicate a mixed population of macrophages and regulatory T cells. The cluster has a high average intensity for DNA1, which could be indicative of a high cell density or a high number of nuclei per cell. The cluster also has low expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, suggesting a lack of epithelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–lymphoid niche
MedGemma.description: Cluster 5 likely represents epithelial-like cells, consistent with the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The presence of CD117 and CD20 suggests a possible co-existence with lymphoid cells. The low expression of myeloid markers (CD68, CD14, CD163, MPO, CD31) and the absence of CD3 and CD8a, along with the presence of CD11c, suggests a potential interaction with immune cells, possibly a regulatory or immune-modulating role. The overall profile is suggestive of a cell type involved in tissue remodeling or immune response, possibly a cell of epithelial origin with immune cell interaction.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells with high TTF1 and Pancytokeratin expression, low immune markers, and low proliferation markers. Consistent with tumour cells.

MedGemma.title: M2-like Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents M2-like macrophages, consistent with the high expression of CD68 and CD163, and low expression of CD14 and CD8a. The elevated CD117 suggests potential involvement in tumor angiogenesis or stromal remodeling. The low expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin is suggestive of a non-epithelial phenotype. The overall profile is consistent with a tumor-associated macrophage population that may contribute to immunosuppression or tissue repair within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: M2-like CD68+CD163+ macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD68 and CD163. The cluster also contains some neutrophils (MPO) and CD117+ cells, which may be mast cells or other myeloid cells. The low expression of CD14 and CD8a suggests that this is not a lymphoid-rich region. The low expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin suggests that this is not an epithelial-rich region. The low expression of DNA1 suggests that this is not a region with high apoptotic activity. The high expression of CD31 and CD94 suggests that this is a region with some vascular and lymphoid components, respectively. The low expression of HLADR suggests that this is not a region with high immune activation. Overall, this cluster is likely a region with high myeloid infiltration and low lymphoid infiltration.

MedGemma.title: Monocyte-Rich, Activated
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a monocyte-rich region with evidence of activation. The high expression of CD68, CD14, and CD163, along with the presence of CD16, suggests an active macrophage population. The presence of CD117, a marker for hematopoietic stem cells and progenitor cells, could indicate a progenitor pool or a region of increased cellularity. The low expression of CD20 and CD3, along with TTF1 and Pancytokeratin, is consistent with a non-epithelial or non-lymphoid cell population. The presence of CD31 and CD3 may suggest endothelial involvement or a transitional state. The overall profile is suggestive of a monocyte-dominated area undergoing activation or differentiation.

BioMistral.title: HLADR+ activated macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD68, CD163, and HLADR. These cells may be activated, as suggested by high CD16 expression and moderate CD4 expression. The cluster also contains some T cells, as indicated by CD3 and CD8a expression. The presence of CD14 and CD11c suggests that some monocytes and dendritic cells may also be present. The low expression of CD20 and CD94 suggests that B cells and NK cells are unlikely to be major components of this cluster.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–B/T interaction
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly tumor cells, given the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The presence of CD20 and CD3 suggests the potential for B-cell interactions or co-expression. The low expression of CD117, CD14, CD68, CD163, CD16, CD31, and CD3 indicates a less myeloid-rich or stromal-like environment. The overall profile is suggestive of a tumor microenvironment with a degree of immune cell interaction, possibly with a focus on epithelial cells. Further investigation is needed to confirm the specific cell type and its role in the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: TTF1+ epithelial cells with immune suppression
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are characterized by high expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin, and low expression of CD117, CD14, CD68, CD163, CD94, and CD31. These cells are likely to be part of the tumour microenvironment, possibly representing a subtype of fibroblasts or myofibroblasts. They may also be associated with immune suppression, as suggested by low expression of CD11c and CD3.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–CD8 T interaction
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly tumor cells, exhibiting a high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, suggesting a lung origin. The presence of CD3 and CD8a indicates the potential interaction with immune cells. The low expression of CD163, CD14, and CD68, along with CD117 and CD31, is consistent with a less macrophage-rich or stromal-like environment. The overall profile suggests a tumor cell population interacting with immune cells, possibly in a region with some degree of immune activity. Further investigation is needed to confirm the epithelial nature and the specific immune cell interactions within this cluster.

BioMistral.title: TTF1+ tumour epithelium in cold immune niche
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1. They are surrounded by a low-density immune microenvironment, with low expression of CD11c, CD14, CD163, CD68, and HLADR. The presence of CD117 and CD31 suggests a possible association with stromal fibroblasts and endothelial structures, respectively.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial-like cells with high proliferation
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly basal or progenitor cells, given the high expression of Pancytokeratin and DNA1. The elevated CD117 suggests increased proliferation and/or stem cell properties. The relatively low expression of immune markers like CD3, CD4, CD8a, and FoxP3 is consistent with a less activated or immune-suppressed state. The presence of TTF1 suggests a lung origin. The overall profile is suggestive of a non-immune cell population with a proliferative capacity.

BioMistral.title: Basal-like proliferative TTF1+ epithelium
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, and low expression of FoxP3, CD11c, CD14, CD163, CD16, CD20, CD31, CD3, CD4, CD68, CD8a, CD94, DNA1, HLADR, MPO, and CD117. These cells are likely to be proliferative, as indicated by high expression of DNA1.

MedGemma.title: FoxP3+ Regulatory T cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster is likely enriched with FoxP3+ regulatory T cells, consistent with the high FoxP3 expression. The presence of CD4 and CD20 suggests a T cell population, potentially a subset of regulatory T cells. The low expression of CD16, CD31, CD117, MPO, TTF1, and Pancytokeratin is suggestive of a non-hematopoietic or non-epithelial cell type. The co-expression of CD3 and CD8a could indicate a T cell population with a more cytotoxic or suppressive phenotype. The overall profile is consistent with a regulatory T cell population, possibly involved in immune suppression or maintaining immune homeostasis within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: CD117+CD163+ immunosuppressive macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD117, and CD163. These cells may be involved in tissue remodelling or immunosuppressive states.

MedGemma.title: FoxP3+ Regulatory T cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely contains FoxP3+ regulatory T cells, consistent with the high FoxP3 expression and low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1). The presence of CD3, CD4, CD8a, CD68, and CD163 suggests a complex immune environment, potentially including activated T cells, macrophages, and possibly some myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs). The high CD117 and CD31 expression could indicate a role in angiogenesis or tumor cell interaction. The low CD11c and CD20 expression is consistent with a lack of classical dendritic cells or B cells. The overall profile suggests a potential role in immune suppression or modulation of the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: CD117+CD163+ myeloid suppressive niche
BioMistral.description: A cluster of cells with high expression of macrophage markers (CD117, CD163, CD68) and low expression of lymphoid markers (CD11c, CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8a, FoxP3). The cells are likely to be macrophages, possibly in an activated state, and may be involved in tissue remodelling or immunosuppressive processes.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–mixed T/B niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly tumor cells, exhibiting a high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, suggesting a lung origin. The presence of CD20 and CD3, along with CD4 and CD8a, indicates a potential interaction with immune cells. The low expression of CD14, CD68, CD163, and CD11c, along with MPO and CD31, suggests a relatively low myeloid or endothelial cell content. The presence of FoxP3 is suggestive of a regulatory T cell population, potentially involved in immune suppression or tolerance within the tumor microenvironment. The overall profile is consistent with a tumor-associated epithelial cell population interacting with a diverse immune cell landscape.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells with high pancytokeratin and TTF1 expression, and low immune markers. Consistent with tumour cells.

MedGemma.title: Immune-Suppressive Myeloid Niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents an immune-suppressive myeloid niche, consistent with the low expression of markers associated with activation and effector functions (e.g., CD3, CD4, CD8a, FoxP3). The high expression of markers like CD68, CD163, and MPO suggests a macrophage-rich environment, potentially contributing to tissue remodeling or immunosuppression. The presence of CD11c and CD14 may indicate the presence of monocytes or macrophages. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1) and markers associated with T cell activation (CD20, HLADR) is suggestive of a non-epithelial, immune-dominant environment. The high expression of DNA1 may indicate a high proportion of cells undergoing DNA replication, potentially associated with proliferation or repair processes within the niche.

BioMistral.title: CD11c+CD68+ myeloid-rich niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD68, and MPO. The cluster also contains a mix of other myeloid cells, including neutrophils (CD16) and dendritic cells (CD117). The presence of CD163 and CD14 suggests a monocyte-like phenotype. The low expression of CD31 and CD3 suggests a lack of endothelial and T cells, respectively. The low expression of CD94 and HLADR suggests a lack of NK cells and dendritic cells, respectively. The low expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin suggests a lack of epithelial cells. The low expression of DNA1 suggests a lack of nucleated cells. The cluster is likely located in a stromal or immune-cold region of the tumour, given the low expression of CD31 and CD3.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, Epithelial-like
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of active immune response, possibly associated with tumour control or tertiary lymphoid structures. The high expression of markers like MPO, HLADR, Pancytokeratin, and TTF1, along with the presence of CD3, CD8a, and CD4, suggests a significant population of immune cells, including cytotoxic T cells and potentially some helper T cells. The relatively low expression of FoxP3 and CD20, along with the absence of strong B-cell markers, is consistent with a less prominent regulatory T cell or B-cell population. The presence of CD117 and CD68 suggests the presence of myeloid cells, possibly macrophages or dendritic cells, which could be involved in antigen presentation or immune modulation. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune-rich environment with a potential epithelial component.

BioMistral.title: MPO/HLADR+ macrophage–epithelial mix
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of MPO and HLADR. The cluster also contains some pancytokeratin-positive cells, which may represent epithelial contamination. The presence of DNA1 suggests that some cells in the cluster are apoptotic. The cluster is characterized by low expression of CD3, CD20, CD11c, CD94, and CD31, which are markers of T cells, B cells, dendritic cells, NK cells, and endothelial cells, respectively. The cluster also has low expression of FoxP3, which is a marker of regulatory T cells. The high expression of CD14 and CD163, which are markers of monocytes/macrophages, further supports the dominance of macrophages in this cluster.

MedGemma.title: Monocyte-Rich, Activated
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a monocyte-rich region with evidence of activation. The high expression of CD14, CD68, and CD163, coupled with the low expression of CD20 and TTF1, is suggestive of a myeloid-derived cell population. The presence of CD16 and HLADR may indicate an activated state, potentially reflecting a role in antigen presentation or immune surveillance. The low expression of epithelial markers like Pancytokeratin and TTF1 further supports a non-epithelial origin. The overall profile is consistent with a monocyte-dominated area involved in tissue remodeling or immune response.

BioMistral.title: CD163+ monocyte-rich activated niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD163, CD14, and CD68. These cells may be involved in tissue remodelling or immunosuppressive states. Low expression of CD20 and CD94 suggests a lack of B cells and NK cells, respectively. Low expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin suggests a lack of epithelial cells. High expression of CD117 and CD11c suggests the presence of mast cells and dendritic cells, respectively. High expression of CD31 and CD3 suggests the presence of endothelial cells and T cells, respectively. High expression of CD4 and HLADR suggests the presence of T helper cells. High expression of MPO suggests the presence of neutrophils. The cluster is likely located in the stroma or interstitial space, rather than within epithelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Malignant Epithelial Cell Cluster
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents malignant epithelial cells, consistent with the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The low expression of CD117, CD14, CD163, CD68, CD31, and HLADR is suggestive of a non-hematopoietic cell type. The presence of CD20 and CD3 may indicate a B-cell component, while CD8a and CD4 could represent T-cell interactions. The overall morphology and marker profile are consistent with a tumor cell population.

BioMistral.title: TTF1+ malignant epithelial cluster
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1, and low expression of immune markers. These cells are likely to be proliferative, as indicated by high DNA1 expression.

MedGemma.title: Myeloid-rich area
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a myeloid-rich niche, consistent with the high expression of CD68, MPO, and CD163. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1) and immune markers (CD3, CD4, CD8a, CD20, CD94) suggests a non-epithelial, non-lymphoid component. The presence of CD117 and CD11c could indicate myeloid progenitors or activated myeloid cells. The overall profile is suggestive of a tissue remodeling or immunosuppressive environment, potentially contributing to tumour progression.

BioMistral.title: CD11c+CD163+ myeloid–epithelial niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c and CD163. The cluster also contains some neutrophils, as indicated by MPO expression. The presence of CD14 and CD68 further supports a macrophage-like phenotype. The cluster is characterized by low expression of CD8a, CD4, and CD3, suggesting a lack of T cells. The low expression of CD94 and HLADR suggests that this cluster is not enriched for NK cells or dendritic cells. The cluster also contains some epithelial cells, as indicated by Pancytokeratin expression. The low expression of TTF1 suggests that these epithelial cells are not likely to be lung epithelial cells. The cluster is characterized by low expression of DNA1, suggesting that it does not contain many apoptotic cells. The cluster is also characterized by low expression of CD117, CD20, and CD31, suggesting that it does not contain many mast cells, B cells, or endothelial cells.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–HLADR+ T niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, possibly tumor cells, exhibiting a high expression of markers like Pancytokeratin and TTF1, suggesting a lung origin. The presence of CD8a and HLADR, along with CD117, indicates potential interaction with immune cells. The low expression of CD20, CD14, CD163, CD16, CD68, and CD94 is consistent with a less activated or less myeloid-rich environment. The overall profile suggests a tumor cell population interacting with the tumor microenvironment, possibly in a relatively immune-active state.

BioMistral.title: Immune-interacting TTF1+ tumour epithelium
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. They are surrounded by a low-density stroma with low expression of DNA1 and HLADR.

MedGemma.title: Myeloid-rich niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a myeloid-rich niche within the tumour microenvironment. The high expression of CD68, CD163, and CD117, coupled with low expression of epithelial markers (Pancytokeratin, TTF1), suggests a predominance of myeloid cells, potentially including macrophages and/or dendritic cells. The presence of CD14 and CD16 further supports this interpretation. The low expression of CD20 and CD3 is consistent with a lack of B-cell involvement. The overall profile is suggestive of a region involved in tissue remodelling or immunosuppression, possibly contributing to the tumour's survival. The high CD31 expression could indicate angiogenesis, which is common in tumours. The low expression of CD16 and CD94 is not consistent with a strong immune response. BioMistral.title: CD11c+CD14+ activated macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD14, and CD163. The cluster also contains some CD68+ cells, which may represent monocytes or mature macrophages. The presence of CD16+ cells suggests that these macrophages may be activated. The cluster is characterized by low expression of CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8a, and TTF1, which are markers of B cells, T cells, and epithelial cells, respectively. The cluster also contains some CD117+ cells, which may represent mast cells or other myeloid cells. The cluster has a high average intensity for CD11c, CD14, CD163, and CD16, which are markers of macrophages. The cluster has a low average intensity for CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8a, and TTF1, which are markers of B cells, T cells, and epithelial cells, respectively.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, Fibroblast-associated

They are also enriched in DNA1, a marker of cell proliferation. These cells are surrounded by low-intensity CD31, a marker of endothelial cells, suggesting a potential role in tumour angiogenesis.

MedGemma.title: Malignant Epithelial Proliferation
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents malignant epithelial cells, consistent with the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, and the presence of DNA1. The high CD117 and CD31 expression suggests active proliferation and angiogenesis. The low expression of FoxP3, CD20, CD68, CD14, and CD163 is consistent with a non-immune-suppressed state. The presence of CD3 and CD8a suggests the presence of cytotoxic T cells, which may be involved in anti-tumor immunity. The overall profile is suggestive of a rapidly proliferating, epithelial-like tumor cell population.

BioMistral.title: CD117+CD68+ activated macrophage–tumour niche
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD117, CD11c, CD14, and CD68. These cells are likely to be in an activated state, as indicated by high expression of CD117 and CD11c, and low expression of FoxP3 and CD20. The presence of CD163 and CD16 suggests that these macrophages may be M2-like, which are associated with anti-inflammatory and tissue-remodeling functions. The presence of CD31 and CD3 suggests that this region may be vascularized, and the presence of CD4 and CD8a suggests that T cells may also be present. The presence of DNA1 and TTF1 suggests that this region may contain epithelial cells, which could be part of the tumor or part of the stroma. The presence of HLADR suggests that this region may be immunologically active. The presence of MPO suggests that this region may contain neutrophils, which could be part of the immune response or part of the tumor microenvironment. The presence of Pancytokeratin suggests that this region may contain epithelial cells, which could be part of the tumor or part of the stroma.

MedGemma.title: Malignant Epithelial Cell-Rich
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of malignant epithelial cells, consistent with the presence of high levels of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The elevated expression of CD117 and CD11c, along with MPO, suggests a potential role in cell proliferation and/or differentiation. The low expression of CD4, CD14, CD8a, HLADR, CD94, and DNA1 is suggestive of a less immune-infiltrated or immune-suppressed environment. The presence of CD20 may indicate the presence of B-cells. Overall, this cluster is consistent with a region of epithelial malignancy.

BioMistral.title: Stroma-rich immune-cold TTF1+ epithelium
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1. They are surrounded by a dense stromal compartment with low expression of CD4 and CD14, and a low density of immune cells with low expression of CD8a and CD94.

MedGemma.title: Myeloid-rich area
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a myeloid-rich niche, consistent with the high expression of CD68, MPO, and CD163. The low expression of CD8a, CD68, HLADR, TTF1, and Pancytokeratin suggests a lack of cytotoxic T cells, a lack of strong antigen presentation, and a lack of epithelial markers. The presence of CD117 and CD11c could indicate the presence of immature myeloid cells or cells with a myeloid-like phenotype. The overall profile is suggestive of a tissue remodeling or immunosuppressive state, potentially contributing to tumour progression. The high CD163 expression could be indicative of M2-like macrophages, which are often associated with tumour promotion. The low expression of CD3 and CD4 could indicate a lack of T cell infiltration, which is consistent with an immune-cold tumour microenvironment. The presence of CD14 and CD16 could indicate the presence of monocytes and macrophages, respectively. The high CD117 expression could be indicative of tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs).

BioMistral.title: CD11c+CD14+CD163+ myeloid-rich region
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD11c, CD14, and CD163. The cluster also contains some neutrophils (MPO) and B cells (CD20). The low expression of CD8a and CD68 suggests that this is not a T cell- or dendritic cell-enriched cluster. The low expression of TTF1 and Pancytokeratin suggests that this is not an epithelial-like cluster. The low expression of HLADR and FoxP3 suggests that this is not a lymphoid-enriched cluster. The low expression of DNA1 suggests that this is not a stromal-enriched cluster. The cluster is likely to be located in a region with high immune activity, given the high expression of CD11c, CD14, CD163, and MPO.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial–immune-contact zone
MedGemma.description: Cluster 17 likely represents epithelial-like cells, consistent with the high expression of Pancytokeratin and TTF1. The presence of CD11c and CD20 suggests co-expression with immune cells. The low expression of CD163, CD94, CD117, CD68, CD31, and HLADR is suggestive of a non-myeloid or non-endothelial phenotype. The overall high intensity of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, coupled with the presence of immune markers, indicates a potential interaction between epithelial cells and the immune microenvironment. Further investigation is needed to determine the specific subtype and functional state of these cells.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells with high TTF1 and Pancytokeratin expression, low immune markers, and low proliferation markers. Consistent with tumour cells.

MedGemma.title: FoxP3+ Regulatory T cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely contains FoxP3+ regulatory T cells, consistent with the high FoxP3 expression. The presence of CD3 and CD4 suggests a T cell population. The low expression of CD11c, CD68, CD16, and MPO, along with the absence of Pancytokeratin and TTF1, is suggestive of a non-hematopoietic or non-epithelial cell type. The high CD31 and CD8a expression may indicate a role in tissue remodeling or immune regulation. The overall profile is consistent with a regulatory T cell population involved in modulating the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: CD68+CD163+ immunosuppressive macrophages
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely the dominant cell type in this cluster, with high expression of CD68 and CD163. These cells may be involved in tissue remodelling or immunosuppressive states.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, Epithelial-like
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of active immune infiltration and epithelial cell presence. The high expression of markers like CD11c, CD16, CD20, and Pancytokeratin, alongside the presence of CD3 and CD4, suggests a T cell-rich environment with possible B cell involvement. The presence of TTF1 and MPO could indicate a lung-specific epithelial component. The relatively low expression of CD8a, CD68, and CD117, along with the high expression of DNA1, suggests a potentially active, but not necessarily exhausted, immune response. The high expression of CD14 and CD163 could indicate macrophage-like cells. The overall picture is suggestive of an immune-active region with a possible epithelial component, potentially involved in tumor control or immune-mediated tumor cell death.

BioMistral.title: Immune-active TTF1+ epithelial region
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are likely to be malignant tumour cells, characterized by high expression of pancytokeratin and TTF1, and low expression of CD8a and DNA1. These cells are also enriched for CD11c, CD16, and CD20, suggesting a possible immune-related phenotype. The presence of MPO and CD117 may indicate an inflammatory or stromal component.
